title: Acoustify catalog (schema version 5)
description: Source of truth for the packaged library. Audio and artwork paths are relative to the library root (the Hugging Face dataset, staged locally under library/). A source is one YouTube video (youtubeId) or an album joined from a YouTube playlist (youtubePlaylistId, each track carrying its own youtubeId). Cross-field rules (unique ids and file paths, each YouTube video used once across sources and tracks, contiguous track timings, last track ending at the duration) are enforced by tools/validate-catalog.mjs.

id.description: Stable unique slug. Changing it orphans likes, playlists and history.

artist.description: Display credit, e.g. "Tyler Childers & Chris Stapleton".

artists.description: Canonical artist entities for browsing. First is the primary artist.

series.description: Optional show/venue/channel series, e.g. "NPR Tiny Desk".

youtubeId.description: Provenance and file id. Optional only when youtubePlaylistId is set.

youtubePlaylistId.description: The YouTube playlist an album was joined from; its tracks carry their own youtubeId.

duration.description: Seconds; the ffprobe duration rounded to 2 decimals.

audio.description: media/<youtubeId>.m4a, or media/<name>.m4a for a joined album.

artwork.description: artwork/<youtubeId>.jpg, or artwork/<name>.jpg for a joined album.

added.description: Date the source entered the library (drives Recently added and NEW badges).

timingConfidence.description: How the boundaries were sourced, e.g. official, community, user.

artists.description: Optional per-track canonical artists; defaults to the source's artists.

youtubeId.description: Optional: the song's own YouTube video (albums joined from several uploads).
